original.statement: The clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout flag is deprecated in favor of clustermesh-sync-timeout and will be removed in Cilium 1.17.

decision.reason: [ev-07d6be356398] says the `clustermesh-ip-identities-sync-timeout` flag is deprecated in favor of `clustermesh-sync-timeout` and will be removed in Cilium 1.17. Deprecated means it still works in 1.16, and the note names a replacement. The proposed condition borrows the Helm-value deprecated-with-replacement pattern: exposed when the old flag is set and the new one is not, with the new flag being set as the overlap (shielded) case. That fits the deprecation described. The evidence names no component, so leaving the flag unscoped is right. The evidence does not say whether setting both flags really shields an environment, and applying the Helm-value pattern to CLI flags is an inference, so confidence is low.
